reasons: Direction is correct: HDI is the vendor (designs, develops, hosts, operates the Site) and the inserted clause imposes the indemnity on HDI in favour of the Company (our client), with no reciprocal Customer indemnity added.

The inserted language reaches the preferred position: third-party IP infringement claims relating to the Site/HDI services and materials, HDI's breach of law, HDI-caused unauthorized access/disclosure, and HDI's gross negligence/willful misconduct, plus standard notice, control-of-defence (with consent limits on settlements imposing liability on the Company) and cooperation mechanics.

Placement is consistent with redline guidance — appended after the warranty subsection (9(b)) and before Section 10 General Provisions — and the drafter reasonably notes survival via the existing Section 10.7 carve-out for Section 9.

Insertion is additive only; no existing text is altered, so the changed-character footprint is the minimum needed for a wholly absent clause, and both deterministic checks pass (operation applies; vendor IP indemnity present).

Comment is accurate, concise, in the required first-person-plural tone with the [Playbook] prefix, and appropriately offers the customary exclusions (Company Content/Marks, specifications, modifications) as a fallback.

Minor nit only (not disqualifying): the rationale describes the insert as new Section 9(c) but the rendered text omits the "(c)" designator — add the subsection letter for clean numbering within Section 9.
